prompt:
Scene:
A square color magazine advertisement illustration showing a wide-angle view of an imagined-future 1958 home kitchen, camera roughly eye-level, slightly low angle to include the rounded ceiling cove. The lighting is the warm soft studio lighting of an idealized mid-century print ad, with no harsh shadows. Paper has subtle halftone grain and very slight offset color misregistration along crisp edges.

Subject:
An optimistic atomic-age suburban kitchen: a large teardrop-shaped refrigerator in polished turquoise enamel with a single chrome spaceship-style handle; a built-in cadmium-red push-button wall oven with five glowing amber buttons; ivory laminate counters edged in chrome; a boomerang-pattern wallpaper above the counter in muted mustard and powder pink; a round bright-yellow clock with thin brass hands on the wall; a single chrome-legged breakfast bar stool in pink vinyl; a glass bowl of plump red tomatoes on the counter. The room is empty of people but feels inhabited and cheerful.

Important details:
Strict atomic-age palette: ivory, turquoise, cadmium red, bright yellow, powder pink, chrome accents. All appliance forms must be bulbous and curved with no sharp modern corners. The wallpaper boomerang motif must repeat cleanly. Keep the vintage magazine-ad feel: halftone print grain, very slight CMYK offset on red outlines, matte paper texture over the whole image, no photographic depth-of-field blur. The room must feel like what 1958 imagined the year 2000 kitchen would look like, not like a real 1958 kitchen and not like a modern retro-styled kitchen.

Use case:
Root reference image for the Turquoise Kitchen Set series. Later images in this series will depend on this room and reuse the same appliances, wallpaper, clock, and palette.

Constraints:
No readable text, no watermark, no logos, no modern stainless steel appliances, no LCD screens, no smartphones, no photorealistic skin, no depth-of-field blur, no sharp minimalist modern lines, preserve exact 1:1 aspect ratio.
title: Kitchen Wide Shot
description: Reference shot establishing the turquoise atomic kitchen room, appliances, and palette for the series.
